members.name: Chirom Meiraba
members.bio: Meiraba, a recipient of Young Scientist Award, is an enthusiastic science communicator. He maintained a good academic record since his high school days and secured 9th Position in HSLC’12. After winning the prestigious INSPIRE Fellowship, he went to IISER Kolkata to pursue BS-MS degree in Chemical Sciences where he also got exposed to teaching as a Teaching Assistant. He underwent training at various places: NTU Singapore (Global Rank 11), National Chemical Lab Pune, IIT Guwahati, and MU and finally went on to receive a DPhil admission offer from the University of Oxford, UK with OCSI Scholarship. He is also a Karateka who won Silver Medal in the Inter Districts. He is using his years of training in research to address issues of education in Manipur by leading a dedicated executive team at MitSna and as its Founder. He is a DAAD alumnus and currently at the University of Houston, Texas, US, as a doctoral candidate.

members.name: Chingkhei Wangjam
members.bio: Chingkhei Wangjam is a public policy professional working in the areas of education policy, capacity building, and skill development. He has over six years of experience designing and implementing large-scale public programmes for the Indian Government, with a focus on translating policy research, field data, and stakeholder inputs into practical and scalable models. He has worked closely with central ministries and state governments to lead capacity needs assessments, develop training strategies, curate learning modules, and train bureaucrats and civil servants in citizen-centric governance. Beyond his work in the public sector, he has been associated with the MitSna Foundation for more than six years in leadership positions, as COO and CSO, contributing to organisational strategy, operations, and youth-focused initiatives aimed at education, skills, and cross-cultural engagement.to his role while contributing effectively to the teams and projects he engages with.

members.name: Thounaojam Raj
members.bio: Thounaojam Raj is a Civil Engineering graduate from NIT Manipur, where he also served as a Training and Placement (TNP) coordinator. Known for his cheerful, adaptive, and hardworking approach, he has honed strong leadership and communication skills through his experience in coordinating placements and working with industry professionals. He is currently working as an Engineer Trainee at Power Grid Corporation of India Limited and has recently been appointed as the Assistant Strategy Officer of Mitsna, bringing a strategic mindset to his role while contributing effectively to the teams and projects he engages with.

members.name: Laishram Yashmine
members.bio: Laishram Yashmine Devi, Assistant Strategy Officer at MitSna, combines a robust scientific background with a passion for educational advancement and social impact. Pursuing her Master’s in Microbiology and Immunology at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU) in Taipei, she holds a Bachelor’s degree in Biology from IISER Tirupati and brings valuable experience in leadership and strategic planning. As a former Campus Director of the Millennium Fellowship, she led initiatives supporting the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals, reflecting her commitment to empowering communities. At MitSna, Yashmine plays a pivotal role in shaping strategies that align with the organization’s mission to promote education and foster growth in Manipur

departments.name: Technology
departments.description: Driving technological innovation and digital transformation

members.name: Dr. Ronaldo Laishram (PhD)
members.bio: Ronaldo Laishram is an astrophysicist, engineer, founder, discoverer, and science communicator who recently completed his PhD in Astronomy at Tohoku University, Japan. With a background in Computer Science Engineering, Ronaldo’s academic journey is distinguished by prestigious scholarships, including the Japanese Government MEXT Scholarship, Japan Science and Technology Fellowship, ILR etc, and is enriched by research experiences at institutions like Caltech, Northwestern University, Subaru Hawaii etc. He was also a Research Fellow at the Indian Space Research Organization and underwent training at various places both in India and abroad, such as Taiwan, Thailand, and Japan.Ronaldo is deeply committed to creating positive societal change through collaboration, believing that lasting impact is achievable only when individuals come together. He actively works to expand educational opportunities and provide resources for Manipur, embodying his vision of a society built on shared efforts and mutual support. Ronaldo believes that real change is only possible through collective action: “I cannot change society alone, and ‘YOU’ cannot do it alone, but together, I + YOU can make a difference.” Guided by this vision, he aspires to create a better society built on shared efforts by supporting underserved communities in Manipur.Balancing scientific inquiry with social responsibility, Ronaldo is dedicated to making a meaningful impact as both a researcher and a global citizen

members.name: Monendra Ningthoujam
members.bio: Monendra Ningthoujam is an ambitious and dedicated professional who graduated with a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from Manipur Technical University. Currently an engineer at Zeta, he has demonstrated his commitment to technological innovation through diverse experiences, including a prestigious internship at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore, under the Summer Research Fellowship (SRF) of the Indian Academy of Sciences, where he worked on machine learning-based wireless network propagation modeling, and an internship at Hexnbit Edtech Pvt. Ltd., Noida, where he honed his technical and problem-solving skills. As a long-standing member of MITSNA since 2019, he has contributed significantly to its initiatives, including the Rebuild Manipur project. Additionally, his volunteer work with the National Service Scheme reflects his passion for community service. Monendra exemplifies a well-rounded individual who blends technical expertise with a commitment to making a positive societal impact.

members.name: Rajkumar Narman Singh
members.bio: Rajkumar Narman Singh, a third-year Computer Science Engineering student at NIT Manipur, has a strong foundation in cybersecurity and a passion for space exploration. A former national table tennis player, he brings discipline and focus to every pursuit. As Mitsna’s Web Development Officer, he is dedicated to advancing our digital presence and creating impactful online experiences.

members.name: Dhanatyashree Yurembam
members.bio: Dhanatyashree is a dynamic individual with strong leadership and teamwork skills. She is a Bachelor of Commerce (Hons.) graduate from the University of Delhi. As General Secretary of the North East Student Group while in college, she has demonstrated her ability to manage and motivate teams effectively. She is adaptable, with excellent communication skills, and thrives in collaborative environments. Dhanatyashree’s involvement in extracurricular activities, including participation in the 2024 G20 Meet in JDMC and earning an NCC ‘C’ Certificate, reflects her discipline and commitment to personal growth. Known for her critical thinking and time management abilities, she excels in diverse roles while maintaining a positive and proactive attitude.

members.name: Mangalsana Khomdram
members.bio: Mangalsana, a very giving person who enjoys working alongside other like-minded people who want to make a difference in the work and suited to the position of volunteer. He is member of MitSna since 2019 and carry on with the executive position. He maintained a good academic record in his high school life. He graduated with Bachelor's degree of Physics honours from DM College of Science, Manipur University. He has completed one year course on Office Automation (PCOA 2020-21) under Pointrex IIT . He is currently pursuing PG Diploma Course in Banking and Finance at MIMS, Manipur University. With love of volunteering, he is a life time member at IRCS. He loves games and sports since childhood. He played Football, Karate, Boxing and Judo in earlier period of his life. And now, he is a State Muay Thai player. One of his hobby is listening to music.

members.name: Lanthouchung Gonmei
members.bio: Lanthouchung Gonmei is a dynamic a fourth-year Architecture student at Pune University, Maharastra with a deep passion for design and a unique flair for Minimalist and Brutalist Architecture. With a passion for leadership, he has served as the Publicity Secretary of Manipur Students Association Pune and as the National Outreach Coordinator for the 67th Year of NASA India (National Association of Students of Architecture).A minimalist design enthusiast at heart, he seeks simplicity and functionality in his work, drawing inspiration from the raw, unadorned beauty of Brutalism. His interests lies in Urban Studies, Planning, and Housing solutions for tribal and marginalized communities. This passion has been further shaped by his involvement with various NGOs. He is currently serving as the International Service Director at the Rotaract Club of Poona South.Beyond academics, his love for travel fuels his curiosity, enabling him to explore diverse architectural styles and cultural landscapes.

members.name: Macmillan Wahengbam
members.bio: Macmillan Wahengbam is a driven and passionate individual with a strong fascination for astronomy, astrophysics, and rocket science. He is currently pursuing his studies to gain a deeper understanding of these fields.In his leisure time, Macmillan enjoys participating in team sports like football and badminton. He is also a music lover and finds it to be a great source of inspiration.Macmillan is committed to giving back to his community and actively participates in volunteer work. He is also an integral part of MitSna, where he utilizes his graphic design skills to contribute to the organization's efforts.Macmillan's ultimate goal is to create a positive impact in his home state of Manipur. He is dedicated to utilizing his skills and knowledge to make a meaningful difference in his community.

members.name: PRETTY RAJKUMARI
members.bio: Pretty Rajkumari is an undergraduate psychology student known for her keen attention to detail and disciplined approach to her work. An introverted extrovert, she enjoys balancing her dedication to tasks with a relaxed demeanor. Outside of work, you’ll often find her immersed in a book, singing, catching up on a movie or drama series, or simply unwinding. A sports enthusiast with a particular passion for basketball, Rajkumari brings both energy and calmness to any environment.
